title: Professional Certificate Course in Project Documentation and Quality Control
description: Understand the stages and benefits of contract management, quality management concepts and tools, total quality management, and project milestone charts.
longDescription: The course is designed to provide participants with an in-depth understanding of contract and quality management in project management. Participants will learn the different stages of contract management and its benefits, types of contracts and contract terms, project document control, project baselines, quality management concepts, quality management tools and techniques, and the concept of total quality management and quality chain. The course will also cover the use of project milestone chart in project management.
courseDetails: This course provides participants with a comprehensive understanding of contract and quality management in project management. Participants will also learn about project document control, project baselines, quality management concepts, quality management tools and techniques, and the concept of total quality management and quality chain. By the end of the course, learners will be equipped with the knowledge and skills to effectively manage contracts and ensure quality in project management.
